items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: INTERVIEWER: He lives with John Henry McNeil uptown, but I don't know if you remember him or not. INTERVIEWEE: No, I do not.

ctx.x: Did King Oliver write to you, or did he call you, or what?

King Oliver wrote to me. But he got to me through Manuel Perez. See, Manuel Perez at that time used to send all the best musicians up to the country, with King Oliver. Whenever they'd need something, Manuel Perez would be the man that would send the musicians up there. So he wrote to Manuel and Manuel got to me and then he wrote to me. Had John ever heard you play? He heard me. My recall, he never heard me play at first. I wasn't even playing when he left here. But after he heard that recalling on my Josephine,…
